graph_model: Paired symmetric raw Gbit/s, full-duplex ports, source-layout mean physical pin metres per link times 44/256. Synthetic capacity expansion and symmetric traffic among connected terminals.
scope: Steady synthetic unicast. Linear, uncapped capacity is a relaxation. Exact fixed-geometry module minima obey intact banks, pin reach and throughput. Temperatures use the specified minimum-hop routing, nominal PHY power and uncalibrated stack. Detailed routing, router overhead, external thermal validation and timing are open.
